name: Suzue Miya
source:
A photographer and the main photographer of Charm's current swimsuit photo shoot.
She is married and her husband is also a photographer but because of their work they often don't see each other. While she loves cute, sexy and pretty girls she isn't a lesbian and because of Yura's feminine looks despite being a boy she dotes on him.
